name: Proxmox VE
author: HostCore
description: Official module for the Proxmox Virtual Environment hypervisor

versions.target_api: Proxmox VE API v2 (PVE 7 or newer)

config_schema.label: Proxmox Host
config_schema.description: Hostname or address of a node in the cluster (eg. pve.domain.com)

config_schema.label: API Token ID
config_schema.description: Preferred credential — an API token id in the form user@realm!tokenid

config_schema.label: API Token Secret
config_schema.description: The secret shown when the API token was created

config_schema.label: Login User
config_schema.description: Used only when no API token is set — a Proxmox user with the realm (eg. root@pam)

actions.label: Shut down
actions.description: Asks the guest to shut down through ACPI. The guest may decline.
actions.confirm: Shut down the server? Anything running on it will stop.

actions.label: Restart
actions.confirm: Restart the server? It will be unavailable while it reboots.

actions.label: Force stop
actions.description: Cuts power to the guest without asking it to shut down.
actions.confirm: Force stop the server? This cuts power immediately and can lose unsaved data.
